root_cause.text: The `amdgpu_acpi_enumerate_xcc()` function in the AMDGPU driver fails to free the allocated `xcc_info` structure when returning early due to an `-ENOMEM` error from `amdgpu_acpi_dev_init()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that when `ret == -ENOMEM` is true, the code previously returned `ret` directly, and the fix adds `kfree(xcc_info)` before the return statement in `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_acpi.c`.

intent_record.how: This ensures allocated memory is properly freed when the initialization function fails with an out-of-memory error, preventing a memory leak.
